newsitem.title: UK: P&O denies delay to Bovis flotation.
newsitem.headline: P&O denies delay to Bovis flotation.

text.p: Peninsular & Oriental Steam Navigation Co Plc on Monday denied a report in the Observer newspaper that it had been forced to delay the flotation of its housebuilding unit, Bovis.
A spokesman for P&O said it was "categorically untrue" that it had been forced to delay or even drop the flotation and that the disposal was on track to take place this year as planned.
The spokesman added that P&O's joint venture in container shipping with Nedlloyd was proceeding well.
He also played down a report in the Financial Times that a government ruling on its planned ferry merger with Stena would likely not be forthcoming until after the election on May 1.
"The timescale is as we previously expected," the spokesman said.
P&O reports results on Tuesday with analysts mostly forecasting a decline in pre-tax profit before exceptionals to between 290 million stg and 316 million, from 320.4 million stg a year before.
The company's shares rallied to be down 3p at 630-1/2 by 1359 GMT, after initially dropping 13-1/2p. Trading volume reached 2.0 million shares.
